message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
The table lists the statutory holiday that creates the extended weekend, the day of the week it fell on, and the provinces/territories where the holiday applies.  

> **Note** – Canada’s holiday calendar is a mix of federal holidays (applicable nationwide) and provincial/territorial holidays (applicable only in certain jurisdictions).  
> The dates shown are the *actual* holiday dates; the long‑weekend period is the holiday plus the adjacent weekend days (Saturday + Sunday).  
> If a holiday falls on a weekend, it does **not** create a long weekend (e.g., New Year’s Day 2023 was on Sunday).  

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Provinces/Territories Covered | Long‑Weekend Span |
|-------------|---------|-------------|------------------------------|-------------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Monday | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island | **Feb 18–20** |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | All provinces & territories | **Apr 7–9** |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | All provinces & territories | **May 20–22** |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | All provinces & territories | **Sep 2–4** |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | All provinces & territories | **Oct 7–9** |
| **Nov 9–11** | Remembrance Day | Monday | All provinces & territories | **Nov 9–11** |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | Monday | All provinces & territories | **Dec 23–25** |
| **Dec 24–26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | All provinces & territories | **Dec 24–26** |
| **Mar 15–17** | St. Patrick’s Day | Friday | Newfoundland & Labrador | **Mar 15–17** |

### Quick Highlights

| Long‑Weekend | Key Holiday | Why it’s a long weekend |
|--------------|-------------|------------------------|
| Feb 18–20 | Family Day | Monday holiday + weekend |
| Apr 7–9 | Good Friday | Friday holiday + weekend |
| May 20–22 | Victoria Day | Monday holiday + weekend |
| Sep 2–4 | Labour Day | Monday holiday + weekend |
| Oct 7–9 | Thanksgiving | Monday holiday + weekend |
| Nov 9–11 | Remembrance Day | Monday holiday + weekend |
| Dec 23–25 | Christmas | Monday holiday + weekend |
| Dec 24–26 | Boxing Day | Tuesday holiday + weekend |
| Mar 15–17 | St. Patrick’s Day (NL) | Friday holiday + weekend |

### How to Use This Data

1. **Filter by Province/Territory** – If your app targets a specific region, filter the table to show only the rows that list that jurisdiction.  
2. **Calendar Integration** – Convert each row into an event with start date = holiday date and end date = weekend day following the holiday.  
3. **User Customization** – Allow users to toggle “include provincial holidays” so they can see the full list or just the federal ones.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (CSV, JSON, iCal, etc.) or if you need additional holidays (e.g., provincial holidays not listed here).
